summary.en: Swap neighboring prisms, clear matching lines, and outscore your friends.
summary.zh-Hans: 交换相邻棱镜，连成同色消除，在十六回合内赢得最高分。

deviceEvidence.iphoneSimulator: PARTIAL: Games→Add→offline-ready→Play→setup observed; one simulator had no second real seat, so no complete match was claimed

notes: The app visibly showed 2–4 players and a recommended standard preset described as a thumb-friendly 5×5 board with sixteen turns. A single simulator cannot prove a two-player result or rematch.
